AWS Control Tower now supports existing Amazon S3 bucket for log delivery
changes.detail: AWS Control Tower now lets you use an existing Amazon S3 bucket in your landing zone to store AWS Config and AWS CloudTrail logs. Previously, AWS Control Tower required you to use the Amazon S3 bucket it creates and manages for log storage. Now, customers who want full control of bucket policies, lifecycle rules, and logging infrastructure can consolidate centralized logs in an Amazon S3 bucket they already manage. changes.title: AWS Transform now provides F5 BIG-IP load balancer migration
changes.detail: AWS Transform now migrates F5 BIG-IP load balancer configurations to Elastic Load Balancing as part of network migration. Applications cut over with Application Load Balancers (ALB) and Network Load Balancers (NLB) already in place allowing you to adopt cloud-native load balancing during migration rather than after it. Moving to ALB and NLB has typically been a separate post-migration project because of time and cost.
